lesson.text: Quick memory: in grade 3 you met fractions of a set. What is 1/4 of 12? 3: 12 shared into 4 equal groups.
A fraction is part of a whole. 3/4 means the whole is cut into 4 equal parts and we take 3 of them.
Different fractions can be the same amount. 1/2 of a wall is the same as 2/4 of it, and the same as 4/8.
To make an equal fraction, multiply the top and the bottom by the same number: 2/3 = 8/12, because 2 × 4 = 8 and 3 × 4 = 12.
To compare fractions, make the bottoms the same, or compare them with 1/2. 3/8 is less than 1/2, which is 4/8. 5/6 is more than 1/2, which is 3/6.
Try it in the world: build a wall of 8 blocks and colour 4 of them. What fraction is coloured? 4/8, which is 1/2. Next: adding and subtracting fractions.

exercises.hint: 8 is 2 × 4: multiply the top by 4 too.
Multiply the top and the bottom of 2/3 by 2.
The parts are the same size: more parts is bigger.
Multiply the top and the bottom of 3/4 by the same number.
The same number of parts: thirds are bigger pieces than fifths.
exercises.explain: Thirds are bigger than fifths, so 2 thirds are more than 2 fifths.

exercises.hint: Half of 12 is 6, half of 8 is 4, half of 6 is 3, half of 5 is 2 and a half.
Make the bottoms the same: twentieths.

exercises.prompt: This wall has room for 8 blocks. Fill 1/2 of it.
exercises.hint: Half of the wall: split it into 2 equal parts.
